verdict.rationale: smolagents publishes its own API reference (reference/agents, with documented parameters such as final_answer_checks, planning_interval and max_steps) and docs containing copyable code examples like CodeAgent(...).run(...). Nothing in the evidence shows this reference is interactive or that the examples can be run in place. The huggingface.co OpenAPI probe is a host-platform artifact and earns no credit. Missing for 10: interactive in-browser exploration of the API reference, runnable or executable examples (e.g. notebooks or live sandboxes linked from the reference), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: final_answer_checks (list[Callable], optional) — List of validation functions to run before accepting a final answer.
planning_interval (int, optional) — Interval at which the agent will run a planning step.
result = agent.run("Calculate the sum of numbers from 1 to 10")
